# Smaller bakery projects — draft price catalogue · 2026-10-11

| Package | One-time EUR | Approx. USD | Scope |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| DIY template licence | 99 | 108 | Template files only; self-installation. No custom content, setup, translation or ongoing service. |
| Baguette — one useful page | 290 | 316 | One responsive page in one language: menu or visit/collection information and a link to an existing order route. Client supplies final text, hours, prices and images. One revision round. |
| Croissant — two clear pages | 490 | 534 | Two responsive pages in one language: a menu and a visit/collection page for one location or a simple location list. Existing checkout stays unchanged. Client-supplied text and images. One revision round. |
| Pâtisserie — three-page enquiry site | 790 | 861 | Up to three template-based pages in one language, with a simple request form handing details to the business by email. Requests are not confirmed orders. Existing checkout remains unchanged. Client-supplied text and images. One revision round. |

All fees are for the specified scope **once**, not per month and not the previous larger package at a discount. EUR is the planning currency; USD/GBP conversions are indicative only. No fee here is a sent quote, contract, revenue or verified customer budget. Tax and feasibility are confirmed before agreement.

Client supplies approved text, hours, prices, images and necessary access. Commissioned packages include one revision round and 14 days of fixes for defects in the agreed work, not new features. Time estimates run after scope, content and access are confirmed. Deposit: 40% after approval of a written scope; balance at delivery. Licence is self-installation, not a build service.

**No required subscription.** Care is optional at EUR 25/month (about USD 27), agreed separately for one small content update/month and agreed technical upkeep. Domains/hosting are in the client's own account and paid by the client. No hosting charge is automatically included in a project or first-year total.

## Not included in the lower fee
- Payment processing or a new checkout
- Inventory, confirmed order slots or delivery integrations
- Multiple custom location sites or a custom CMS
- Translation or additional-language content entry
- Photography, branding or custom illustration
- SEO campaigns or ranking/sales guarantees
- Migration of customer data
- Hosting, domains, subscriptions or ongoing care
- Unlimited revisions

The kit demos may demonstrate more technical capabilities than a purchased scope includes. They are concepts with sample content, not client work, real menus, or promises of an entire store for a one-page fee. Extra work requires a separately approved quote; no silent add-ons or misleading upsell.
